title: Workflows as records: each walk from a draft to a report as one record linking its moves, stages, decisions and agent runs
request: A WorkflowRecord for every walk, each step linked to the ledger's decisions and the agent steps inside it.
plan: A WorkflowRecord contract with steps in time order.
A builder over drafts, transitions, stages, the ledger and the experience log.
A keeper keeping each walk, a new version when it moved on.

decisions.decision: A step holds names, codes and counts, never the person's words.
decisions.why: Those stay in their own records; the walk links to them.

change: dclab_core.store.WorkflowRecord and WalkStep, dclab_rnd.store.workflows (walk, walks, the walks keeper).
outcome: Every walk is one record whose steps link back to every decision and agent run it made.
lessons: A record that links by id stays small and stays true to its sources.
risks: Stage times come from the stage records; a stage with no time is left out of the order.
